summary: P1.8 Fleet File Trajectory + digest-semantics correction — full backend + frontend acceptance. All 14 items in the review request PASS with no defects. GET /api/edr/fleet-spread-index returns 49 rows; powershell.exe=3 endpoints/9 unique events; winword.exe=2 endpoints/2. name:winword.exe has creators=[] (empty). sha256:0000…0000 returns unique=0/raw=0. PATH/NAME KEYED — CONTENT-BLIND', fleet-metric-endpoints=3, fleet-metric-unique=14 labelled 'authoritative · event.iid deduplicated', fleet-metric-raw=58 labelled 'all provenance copies · NOT unique activity' (two figures are visibly separate and raw is explicitly labelled raw), fleet-entry-point shows '? 2 ENDPOINTS TIE ON THE EARLIEST TIMESTAMP — NO SINGLE ENTRY POINT IS CLAIMED' with both ENG-42 (dev_a0267ae20737) and WKS-07 (dev_fd5461195689), fleet-creators shows 'powershell.exe / C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe / file_create on FIN-07 · 2026-02-25T14:00:09Z'. Winword page correctly shows '◇ PARENT CREATOR NOT OBSERVED'. fleet-identity shows OBSERVED NAMES powershell.exe, updater.exe, OBSERVED PATHS C:\Users\bob\AppData\Roaming\updater.exe, and SHA-256/SHA-1/MD5 all '◇ NOT OBSERVED · artefacts.file[].sha256 EMPTY'. fleet-endpoint-ledger renders 4 rows including honest '◇ UNBOUND — NO DEVICE IDENTITY ON THESE RECORDS' row and 3 authoritative device rows; every row shows OS/Platform '◇ NOT REPORTED', case ids '◇ CASE RECORD NOT PERSISTED', Response '⊘ RESPONSE DRIVER NOT REGISTERED'. Endpoint pivot fleet-pivot-dev_a0267ae20737 navigates to /xdr/endpoints/dev_a0267ae20737/trajectory?focus=powershell.exe, xdr-navigator-search is pre-filled with 'powershell.exe', xdr-navigator-search-status shows '4 matches · text', earliest match auto-selected and edr-activity-narrative populated (908 chars). Reverse pivot: on FIN-07 trajectory both edr-details-fleet-trajectory (button, NOT disabled) and edr-ctx-file-trajectory (context-menu item, NOT disabled anymore) navigate to /xdr/intelligence/files/name%3Awinword.exe and land on a populated fleet page. Honest zero state: /xdr/intelligence/files/sha256%3A0…0 renders fleet-empty with '◇ NO OBSERVATIONS FOUND FOR THIS KEY IN THE PERSISTED SUBSTRATE' plus explanation '0 of 53 file artefacts carry a SHA-256'; no synthetic endpoints. Tenant boundary sentence present on the fleet page ('v2_shadow_observations carries no tenant_id …'). Digest-semantics regression on Device Trajectory: Activity Details pane shows a 'FILE SHA-256 / ◇ NO FILE CONTENT DIGEST OBSERVED · artefacts.file[].sha256 IS EMPTY' row AND a separate 'EVIDENCE DIGEST / 5168c4ae…162a29fb ? RECORD DIGEST · NOT A FILE HASH' row; narrative contains 'Evidence integrity: the ingested observation record digests to … — that is the record's digest, not the digest of any file it describes.' and 'No file content digest was captured: artefacts.file[].sha256 is empty on this record.' Static Analysis Bridge now renders THREE lookups: edr-static-lookup-file (◇ NO STATIC ANALYSIS RECORD), edr-static-lookup-cmdline (SHA256 of observed command line), edr-static-lookup-input (event.raw.sha256 == input_sha256). Phases A–D regression: lifeline canvas with 8 lifelines + ghost-root markers, compromise band, events ledger, filters modal wiring, disabled response shelf, sidebar focus mode on trajectory routes — all still render. Only console noise is expected React-Router-v7 future flag warnings and expected 404s from /api/v2/decoded-artifacts/{sha256} (honest 'no record').
critical_code_review_comments: Fleet spread-index rows for powershell.exe show unique_events=9 (per-name event.iid dedupe across devices, correct), but the same key on the fleet page shows unique_events=14 because the fleet aggregator also matches process.image leaf, artefacts.file[].path leaf, and raw.entity while the spread index only unions process.name + artefacts.file[].path leaf. Both figures are internally consistent but analysts pivoting between the two panels will see 9 vs 14. Consider adding a one-line footnote under fleet-spread-index or aligning both to the same matcher.

The 'ledger row → Activity Details fleet-trajectory' button on Device Trajectory navigates using the observation's leaf name (e.g. winword.exe when clicked on a winword row). That is correct for the process-executed row but on artifact rows (network/registry) the leaf may not exist — verify that edr-details-fleet-trajectory is disabled/hidden on rows without an artifact leaf so it never navigates to /xdr/intelligence/files/name%3A (empty key) and produces a bare fleet-empty page.

fleet-endpoint-ledger repeats up to 5 identical 'CASE RECORD NOT PERSISTED' pills per device row — for ENG-42 this yields ~5×3=15 pills stacked. Collapse to '5 case references · none persisted (Show all)' as already suggested for compromise-cases in iteration_83.
seed_data_creation: None. Verified against pre-existing v2_shadow_observations (639 docs / 7 devices / 53 file artefacts, none with sha256).
